2.jpg.title: Shift-P, Landscaping, Banana Regrow
2.jpg.text: Point the tool at a plantation to see how many plants it has.

3.jpg.title: Mark an area
3.jpg.text: Click two opposite corners: the area is outlined and its plants are counted.

4.jpg.title: Harvest and cut back
4.jpg.text: Ripe plants are harvested into the washing station, the rest are cut back so they regrow.
